Happy Hour Hours Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday: 5:00 PM - 6:30 PM Friday and Saturday: dinner service only, from 5:00 PM Monday: closed Also Happening Martini Wednesdays - $12 martinis, 7:00 to 9:00 PM Weekend Brunch - Saturday and Sunday with $25 bottomless mimosas Where to Find Us Port Union, 1559 N Milwaukee Ave, Chicago, IL 60622 . In Wicker Park at the crossroads of Bucktown, steps from the Damen Blue Line. Call (312) 363-3110 or reserve on Resy or Yelp. Happy Hour FAQ What days is happy hour at Port Union? Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, from 5:00 to 6:30 PM. There is no happy hour on Friday or Saturday, and we are closed Mondays. Do I need a reservation for happy hour? No. Walk-ins are welcome at the bar and high-tops. You can also reserve a table on Resy if you prefer. Where is happy hour served? At the bar, the high-tops and in the dining room - the full room, not just the bar. How much are the oysters? One dollar each with any beverage purchase, dine-in only, during happy hour. Are there vegetarian options at happy hour? Yes. The turnip causa and the pan de ajo are both vegetarian, and the turnip causa is fully plant-based. Is there happy hour on the weekend? Sunday, yes - 5:00 to 6:30 PM. Friday and Saturday are regular dinner service, with the full menu from 5 PM.
